## 2. Earned Leave  
1. Credit.Credit will be afforded in advance at a uniform rate of 15 days on the 1st of January and 1st of July every year. The credit to be afforded will be reduced by Yio th of extraordinary leave availed and/or period of dies non during the previous half-year, subject to a maximum of 15 days and to the extent of such credit only. - GID (2), Rules 26 (1) and 27 (3).
